skills-clean-energy.title: CleanEnergyComp
skills-clean-energy.purpose: ENEC's sustainability competence framework: twelve competences in four areas, with learning outcomes and role targets.

skills-clean-energy-competence.title: CleanEnergyComp competence
skills-clean-energy-competence.purpose: One competence: what it means at a nuclear plant, learning outcomes in English and Arabic, skills and learning.

my-clean-energy.title: My CleanEnergyComp
my-clean-energy.purpose: My level in each competence and overall against my job family's target, with what to grow next.

workforce-clean-energy.title: CleanEnergyComp across the workforce
workforce-clean-energy.purpose: Share of staff at each level and at their family target, by area and family; small groups suppressed.

learn-energy-transition.title: Energy transition learning
learn-energy-transition.purpose: Hydrogen, process heat and grid value chains, the energy-system pathway and the ESG and GHG track for managers.

learn-esg-managers.title: ESG and GHG literacy for managers
learn-esg-managers.purpose: A short, sourced pathway completable in under 10 hours, with a micro-credential route.

learn-energy-chain.title: Value chain explainer
learn-energy-chain.purpose: One energy-system value chain: stages, sourced facts, skills and the pathway.

areaSub.values: Public trust, stewardship and fairness across generations.
areaSub.complexity: Systems thinking under uncertainty, lifecycle carbon and critical use of evidence.
areaSub.futures: Net-zero pathways, the role of nuclear in an integrated energy system and new technologies.
areaSub.acting: Waste stewardship, circularity and advocacy with evidence.

greencomp.complexity: GreenComp area: embracing complexity in sustainability

fw.intro: Twelve sustainability competences for a nuclear energy company, in four areas authored with the GreenComp method. Each has learning outcomes in English and Arabic, the skills that evidence it, learning items and a target for every job family.

method.title: Authored with the GreenComp method
method.body: GreenComp (European Commission JRC, 2022) sets out twelve sustainability competences in four areas and is a reference for designing learning, not a curriculum. CleanEnergyComp keeps its structure and writes each competence for a nuclear plant.

national.title: Linked to national frames
national.body: Every competence is tagged to the New Economy group of the federal Jahiz future-skills platform (net zero, circular economy and sustainability) and to the UAE Net Zero 2050 strategic initiative.

rule.title: How a level is reached
rule.body: Your level in a competence is your best counted skill state among its linked skills (verified, evidenced or validated; self-ratings never count). Your CleanEnergyComp level is the highest level you reach in all four areas.

cta.body: See your level in each competence, what counts as evidence and what to grow next.

matrix.title: Framework at a glance
matrix.intro: Each competence with its GreenComp area, learning outcomes, FS02 future skills, learning items and national tags.

levels.title: Levels
levels.intro: Three levels, described the same way for every competence.
levels.d1: Explains the idea and its basis, and applies it with guidance in their own work.
levels.d2: Applies it independently in their role and helps the team do the same.
levels.d3: Leads and advises others, shapes decisions and explains them outside the team.

targets.title: Role targets
targets.intro: A target level and focus competences for every job family, with the reason.

check.title: Framework check
check.pass: All {n} competences and {m} family targets pass: outcomes in both languages, GreenComp area and source, a future skill and learning for each.
check.clean: Public copy passes the check: no staffing figures, location or project claims.

comp.intro: What the competence means at a nuclear plant, its learning outcomes in both languages, and how to build it.
comp.outcomesIntro: Each outcome in English and in Arabic.
comp.skillsNote: Highlighted chips are FS02 future skills; the others are established catalogue skills that also count.
comp.focusIntro: Job families whose target names this competence as a focus.
comp.noFocus: No family names it as a focus yet

my.intro: Your level in each CleanEnergyComp competence comes from your counted skill states on its linked skills. Self-ratings are shown but never counted.
my.none: CleanEnergyComp progress is for ENEC staff
my.areaNone: No counted evidence in this area yet

statusLine.met: You are at level {level}, which meets your family target of level {target}.
statusLine.below: You are at level {level}; your family target is level {target}. Grow the competences in the list below.
statusLine.none: At least one area has no counted evidence yet, so your overall level is 0. One counted skill in that area gets you to level 1.
statusLine.no_target: You are at level {level}. Your job family has no CleanEnergyComp target.

my.nextIntro: Focus competences of your family first, then the largest gaps to your target.
my.goalBody: This adds {skill} at level {level} by {date} to Skills I want to grow. Only you see it unless you share it with your manager.
my.credNone: Eligibility is not available for this account.
my.credEligible: You meet every criterion: earn it on the credential page

how.title: What counts
how.body: Verified, evidenced and validated skill states count: qualifications, courses, assessments, checks and validated check-ins. Ask your manager to validate a self-rating in a skill check-in.

private.title: Private to you
private.body: Your CleanEnergyComp profile is computed for you only. HR sees only aggregates of at least ten people.

wf.intro: CleanEnergyComp across active staff: share at level 1 or above and at their family target. Any cell naming fewer than ten people is suppressed.
wf.none: This view is for HR aggregate readers

tile.l1Sub: Counted evidence in all four areas
tile.familiesSub: Security, safeguards and cyber never broken out

wf.areaIntro: Share of staff with at least one counted competence in each area.
wf.famIntro: Families with fewer than ten active staff show as suppressed.

how.title: How it is computed
how.body: The same rule as each person's own view: best counted skill state per competence, lowest area as the overall level, compared with the family target.

hub.intro: How nuclear energy could connect with hydrogen, industrial heat and the grid, and the skills that go with it. Concept learning with sourced facts; no ENEC project, site or deployment decision is implied.

tile.factsSub: Each with a source and as-of date

concept.title: Concept learning
concept.body: These explainers describe how energy systems can work and which skills they need. They make no claim about ENEC projects or sites, and no deployment decision is implied.

hub.chainsIntro: From the energy source to the user, with the role a nuclear plant could play at each stage.
hub.tracksIntro: Each track is a future-skill pathway with an envelope and a weekly hour cost, like every other pathway.
hub.cecBody: The tracks build the futures and acting competences of ENEC's sustainability competence framework.

chain.intro: One value chain: its stages, the role a nuclear plant could play, sourced facts and the pathway that builds the skills.
chain.stagesIntro: Read from the energy source to the user.
chain.factsIntro: Every fact links its source and the date it was read. Secondary sources report a primary publication.
chain.pathwayIntro: Envelope, weekly hours and steps; your progress comes from your own records.

track.startBody: You start {title}. Progress is worked out from your own records; you can leave at any time.
track.quickOk: Every step has an item that fits its planned hours: {n} h in total.
track.quickNo: Some steps have no item that fits their planned hours ({n} h planned).

cred.title: Counts toward {code}
cred.draftBody: This micro-credential is still a draft, so it cannot be earned yet. The pathway already covers its criteria.

esg.intro: A shared baseline for managers who report on sustainability and human capital: greenhouse-gas accounting basics, disclosure and reporting concepts, in under 10 hours.
esg.cost: {total} hours in total, about {weekly} h a week over {months} months.
esg.routeIntro: Four steps; the quickest item in each fits its planned hours. The check counts toward MC-CLEAN-ENERGY.
esg.whyBody: Managers increasingly report on sustainability and human capital. ISO 30414:2025 asks for quantitative and qualitative disclosure with explanations; this track gives everyone the same baseline.

reason.claimed: {n} linked skill(s) are self-rated only; a self-rating counts once a manager validates it
reason.none: No counted evidence yet on its {n} linked skills
reason.met: Level {level} meets your family target of {target}
reason.below: Level {level} is below your family target of {target}
reason.noTarget: Level {level}; your job family has no target
reason.focus: A focus competence for your job family
reason.levelNone: At least one area has no counted evidence, so the overall level is 0
reason.levelMet: Overall level {level} (the lowest area) meets your family target of {target}
reason.levelBelow: Overall level {level} (the lowest area) is below your family target of {target}
reason.levelNoTarget: Overall level {level} (the lowest area); no family target
